_comment: One approval file per DAY, accumulating. Every action approved on this date appears here; an actions agent executes an id only if it is present with status 'approved'. Append, never replace -- a later run that overwrites this file erases the authorisation record for everything approved earlier the same day, and would let a resumed earlier run find its own id missing.
